title: Seven Ways to Stand Together
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter II, Episode 7: Seven Ways to Stand Together. There were two of them now, and two notes are not a chord — they are only a question. So the Keeper stopped fighting with the notes and started calling them. Do Mi Sol: he already knew that one. Re Fa La — a chord he had never heard. Fa La Do: shelter. La Do Mi — this one was the Elder's colour. Ti Re Fa: a chord that stands on nothing. Seven notes, and seven ways to stand together. And then the last one, which was not a chord at all but two chords in a row: Sol Ti Re, into Do Mi Sol. This one did not push. It pulled. Every song wants to come home — and he had nowhere to come home to.  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #chords #storytelling
